_revision_note: Resolved 2026-09-06 via huggingface_hub.model_info(...).sha. Pre-quantized 4-bit compressed-tensors (pack-quantized, group_size 32, symmetric int4) build of Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507; 18.09 GB of safetensors.

quantization._note: The checkpoint self-describes through config.json quantization_config (quant_method compressed-tensors), so no transformers-side quantization_config is passed. Every layer's mlp.gate is in the compressed-tensors ignore list, so the routers stay bf16.

_pilot_verdict: DOES NOT FIT. transformers 5.16.1 stores Qwen3-MoE experts as fused 3-D nn.Parameter, while this checkpoint stores them per expert as nn.Linear weight_packed/weight_scale/weight_shape. quantizer_compressed_tensors.update_weight_conversions prepends integrations/compressed_tensors.py DecompressExperts to the qwen2_moe expert WeightConverter, which DEQUANTISES every expert to bf16 before MergeModulelist/Concatenate fuse them, so the ~29.0 B expert parameters land in VRAM as bf16 (~58 GB). See the measured failure in the pilot report.
